notes.title: PC Playability Update
notes.content:
In its first major update, Nomad Station is now accessible to players without a VR headset! VR players now have the option to start the game with or without their headset. Simply launch the game and it will detect if there is a headset connected and the input will be adjusted automatically.

[h3]Included in this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]PC compatibility implemented
[*]Ammo count displays now in more convenient location
[*]Added option to turn-off sitting height detection
[*]Squashed these bugs:
-Grenades occasionally pass through walls when thrown
-Weapon belt moves around too much when trying to laser-grab a weapon from it
-Other minor pesky bugs
[/list]
